notes: Single source: BINDER MKFT 240 product page, snapshot research/v5/cache/87f30350de2c404b.txt (fetched 2026-10-31; no earlier cache existed). Standard configuration article 9020-0383 (MKFT240-400V, 400 V / 50 Hz, 6 kW, 16 A, 67 dB(A), 415 kg empty). Geometry: 1115 W x 1940 H x 925 D mm housing box on 4 castors (two with brakes), single front door with heated viewing window and LED lighting; inner stainless steel chamber 735 W x 700 H x 443 D mm = 228 L with 1 rack standard (6 max). The only sample-wiring route fitted as standard is the 50 mm silicone-plugged access port on the left wall; the page lists no electrical feedthrough or line count, so wiring is recorded as that one port (count 1 = ports, not conductors). Optional ports (30/80/100/125 mm left/right/top, 100 x 35 mm door notch) are NOT fitted in this configuration. Thermal: -70 to +180 C (203.15 to 453.15 K), humidity 10-98 % RH only between 10 and 95 C; heating 5.0 K/min (-40 to 180 C), cooling 4.2 K/min (180 to -40 C), 180 to -70 C in 110 min; uniformity 0.2-1.8 K, fluctuation 0.1-0.5 K. Cooling is a cascade compressor unit (R-452A / R-23) with 20 L internal water tank for vapour humidification; no cryogen. No stage plates exist in this archetype: 'stages' records the chamber air-temperature set-point extremes. Viewing-window size, fan speed and compressor speed are not published on the page; no datasheet PDF was found linked on it. For the 3D model: box with front door; animate door hinge, compressor hum and chamber air flow; the LED-lit window is on the door, size unknown, so do not invent a diameter.
